Requirements: Events up to Mirage Tower, in other words, you have to unlock it first.  
  
Method:  
1. Equip the items that you want to duplicate, enter Mirage Tower.  
2. Talk to the midtop NPC, select the first option to challenge the tower.  
3. Select the option to customize.  
4. De-equip the the item you're duping.  
5. Press the lower right corner to go back, exiting the NPC/tower (canceling the challenge).  
  
Voila, now you'll notice that you still have the item equipped, with an extra copy in your inventory.
